thinking: Model officially supports non-thinking only; no enable_thinking override
policy_source: Experiment-defined mappings, not official policy names. Official outputs are Safe/Controversial/Unsafe. error/unknown are execution states, never successful harmful identification.
fixed_refusal: I’m sorry, but I can’t help with that request.
unknown_action: do not release; fixed refusal; count separately as exception
offline: Generate A/C once even when input-blocked for B/D; input-blocked B/D has no simulated generator invocation. Never call offline compute time online protection latency.
